bodies.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production character-creation comparison atlas for a dark medieval fantasy RPG website, with six selectable body structures of a living Warforged construct. Generate ONE clean illustrated atlas arranged in an exact 3 columns by 2 rows equal-size grid, all six cells on the same warm charcoal background, no lines, no frames, no letters, no labels, no numbers. Each cell contains exactly one complete full-body humanoid living construct, head to feet fully visible with generous equal margins. Same neutral standing front three-quarter pose, same camera, consistent fantasy painted concept-art quality, readable large silhouette, weathered iron plates with wood fiber joints and small aged brass fasteners, no weapons, shields or clothing covering the body. Neutral material colors for comparison, soft diffuse side light, no floor or cast shadow crossing cell borders. Top row left: balanced medium-width chest and proportional arms and legs. Top row middle: noticeably slender narrow torso, slim shoulders, fine limbs. Top row right: very robust broad chest and wide shoulders, thick limbs and waist. Bottom row left: medium torso with visibly oversized reinforced arms, large forearms and shoulders, balanced symmetrical arms. Bottom row middle: narrow-medium torso and clearly elongated legs with articulated knees, normal arms. Bottom row right: compact stocky trunk with shorter thick limbs, broad lower center of gravity. Exactly two attached arms, two hands and two legs per figure, anatomically coherent symmetrical joints; every head, hand and foot contained in its own cell. Each option must have a clearly distinct silhouette while all remain recognizably medieval living constructs, not futuristic robots. No human skin, no horns, no glowing effects, no modern machinery, no text, no watermarks. Landscape canvas, ideally 1536 by 1024.

heads.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production character-creation comparison atlas of SIX original Warforged HEAD shapes for a dark medieval fantasy RPG website. Inspired by the diverse living metal-and-wood construct silhouettes seen in a Warforged fantasy character reference board: masks, visors, faceted faceplates, and articulated jaws. Create ONE atlas in an exact 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells on uniform warm charcoal background. No labels, letters, numbers, frames or dividing lines. Each cell shows ONE clearly different head and short neck only, no shoulders, consistently near-front three-quarter orientation, equal visual scale, generous 12 percent margins, complete cranium and chin visible inside each cell. Detailed painted fantasy concept art, weathered neutral gray iron with aged brass fasteners and wood-fiber joints, soft studio side lighting; eyes muted warm amber, not beams. Top left: elongated smoothly curved closed face mask with two small almond eye openings, no mouth opening. Top middle: wide horizontal single dark visor slit across a compact rectangular head, flat chin. Top right: sharply faceted geometric head, angular cheek plates and a central ridged forehead, two narrow eyes. Bottom left: rounded head with two distinct circular recessed eye lenses and a small flat mouth grille, no goggles strapped on. Bottom middle: humanoid face built from interlocking segmented metal cheek and jaw plates, strong clearly articulated lower jaw and two eye sockets, no human skin or teeth. Bottom right: domed broad cylindrical head with riveted arched crown, small deep-set eye slots and a broad flat lower faceplate, no helmet worn over a head. These are actual constructed heads, not removable helmets. Make all SIX silhouettes unmistakably different. One head per cell, no horns, no ears, no jewelry, no weapons, no modern electronics, no text or watermark. Landscape canvas ideally 1536 by 1024.
